acceptanceScope: Operator-owned two-replica local production-mode fixture; immutable application source only.
purpose: Functional correctness, exact query accounting and resource observation; not controlled timing comparison.
applicationHashDefinition: SHA256 of git blob bytes at sourceBuild.
operatorHashDefinition: SHA256 of filesystem bytes at handoff; explicit historical setup/transport corrections are retained below, not a preregistered timing protocol.

deployment.webRuntime: two independent host Next.js production processes using a shared read-only artifact

summary.clockRestoration: out, verified by authoritative public header cleanup

backendDecision.choice: retain installed per-process memory for the observed topology
basis: Both replicas independently fill and repeat-hit correctly.
Fresh committed revision keys make A writes and reduced scope effective on B before TTL.
Eight concurrent requests per node use one computation per node, with150queries each including fresh admission.
A native-get outage does not trigger raw recomputation; B stays healthy and A recovers immediately.
Replacing A discards its cache; B retains its warm result inside the same lifetime.
backendDecision.resourceLimit: RSS/heap include framework, workers and transient range processing; they are not measurements of cache allocation.

versioning.storageLifetime: per process; no cross-process or cross-build persisted Cache Components store
